name: Sandskin
oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by enchanted creature.
blocked_sentences: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by enchanted creature.

needs.what: a continuous prevent_damage static that also stops damage dealt BY the permanents its filter matches (a 'dealt': 'to' | 'by' | 'to_and_by' axis like the op's), combinable with combat_only and prevent_all, so an Aura can say 'prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by enchanted creature' with affects {attached: true}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The prevent_damage static (with combat_only and prevent_all) only prevents damage dealt TO what its affects matches, so it covers half the sentence; damage_source names a dealer but is accepted only on replace_damage, which requires damage_multiplier >= 2 and cannot prevent; the prevent_damage_permanent op has dealt: to_and_by but is a one-shot with a this_turn/until_your_next_turn duration, covers all damage rather than combat only, and cannot be continuous while the Aura is attached
